title: D2P Extensions
description: Extension mechanism: an 'extensions' object maps reverse-DNS extension namespaces to extension blocks. Every top-level document and every entity with an 'id' MAY carry an optional 'extensions' member; value objects do not. An extension MUST NOT change the meaning of standard members, and consumers MUST NOT silently drop or reinterpret extension content. The root accepts an extensions object.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Map from extension namespace to extension block. The reserved namespace 'd2p' cannot appear as a key.

extensionBlock.title: Extension block
extensionBlock.description: Data of one extension namespace on the carrying object.

provenance.description: Who publishes the extension and where it is specified.

onUnknown.description: Required behaviour of consumers that do not understand this namespace.

data.description: Extension-defined content (open object, preserved verbatim by consumers that do not understand it).

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Publisher and references of an extension, feature capability or measurement mapping.

publisher.description: Name of the publishing organisation or project (never a private individual's personal data).

uri.description: Home page or registry entry of the extension.

onUnknown.title: Unknown-extension behaviour
onUnknown.description: 'ignore': process normally and preserve the block verbatim when writing back. 'read-only': display and validate, but MUST NOT modify the carrying object or its descendants (D2P-SEM-007, warning). 'reject': refuse the document (D2P-SEM-006, error).
